summary: HeartCore Enterprises sold its 51% majority stake in Sigmaways, Inc. (229,500 shares) and $2.19M in promissory notes to Semaphore Technologies. Consideration is up to $650,000: $1,000 cash at close plus up to $649,000 earn-out equal to 10% of Sigmaways gross revenue above $5.5M over 12 months. Additionally, a SAFE note in Heart-Tech Health (original $350,000) was contributed as part of mutual releases. The transaction closed on June 22, 2026. Watch for earn-out metrics and potential collections on the transferred debt.
